reason: When I get stuck I just call mum, and a free AI chat already answers cooking questions, so I can't justify 99 baht a month out of my allowance. The two free dishes are basil pork and pork omelet, which I already make without thinking.
objection: Why pay an app to tell me what mum or a free AI chat will tell me for nothing? 99 baht is two plates of krapow for something I already get free.
would_change_my_mind: Friends I trust actually cooking from it and telling me the dishes taste like home, not like app food.
